properties.comment: Region Results summary over aggregation periods.

fields.name: WEIGHT

fields.doc: Weighted average USE per region = (USE_AVERAGE_POE10/NATIVE_DEMAND_POE_10*WEIGHT_POE_10 + USE_AVERAGE_POE50/NATIVE_DEMAND_POE_50*WEIGHT_POE_50)*100
fields.name: USE_WEIGHTED_AVG

fields.name: LRC
